resources.string: Using %1$s is at your own risk. This app connects to your own Lightning wallet - you are fully responsible for the funds in your wallet and any payments made.\n\nWe strongly recommend connecting wallets with small spending balances or using NWC connections with limited budgets.
You\'ll create a connection in your wallet and bring the connection string back to %1$s.
In your wallet, create a new NWC connection for %1$s.
Set a reasonable budget and enable payment permissions.
Scan the QR code or paste the connection string on the next screen.
